retained_artwork.144: Approved Red Style Mastery Goku artwork and placement

wording_scope: Standalone Combat categories and category-specific references become Event. Non-Combat references are resolved to Setup or Drill. Physical Combat, Energy Combat, proper card names and Combat timing remain distinct. Supplied Expanded CRD reviewed; previously deferred cards unchanged.

interpretation_notes.143: The original Non-Combat/non-Dragon Ball reference selects the modern Setup and Drill families.
interpretation_notes.rarity: Rare = 5 stars, Ultra Rare = 6 stars (2/3/1 rows), Starter = 4 stars.
interpretation_notes.numeral_5: Native outline traced from official Fusion World FB11-016, extending the same reference family used by the approved 1–4 numerals; no fallback font.

review_surfaces: Full-card inspection of Mastery, PUR 5 and Ultra Rare examples
checks: Subjects, actions, costumes and original framing
Native outlined titles, rules, icons and footers
Rare five-star, Ultra Rare six-star and Starter four-star marks
All 29 Personality stage charts, LEVEL and PUR values
Namek Dragon Ball 5 star count and approved Porunga artwork
Six Mastery styles with approved pointed geometry and matching style symbols and colors

corrected_during_review.154: Restored the original 70,000 stage value in place of the initial 65,000 transcription.
